q1_issues.issue: A scalar-change subject takes Theme, not Patient, so 'fell' should give (Theme sk_fall_1 us2yt_rr).
The stated delta 'fell 5/32 in price' is dropped entirely - no MeasureBy on the fall event - losing both the magnitude and the clause-stated dimension noun 'price'.
The from-value is asserted as the bearer's own past standing Measure; a stated change's start value takes (MeasureFrom <event> ...) on the change eventuality.

The to-value is asserted as the yield's own timeless Measure, which the Scalar change section explicitly bars ('never becomes the bearer's own timeless Measure'); it takes MeasureTo on the change event.
(Past sk_take_1) tenses a participial adjunct ('taking'), but a participle never carries a tense atom of its own - only finite clauses do.
The time adjunct 'late on Monday' is dropped with no atom anywhere in the parse.

q2_gaps: a fractional bond-price magnitude ('5/32') in a Measure/MeasureBy magnitude slot - magnitudes are native numbers and (Fraction n d) is licensed only as a ProportionOf level
a time adjunct scoping over only the from-value of a scalar change ('from 1.16 percent late on Monday') - MeasureFrom has no time slot and attaching Monday to the fall event would misdate it
notes: Compound-kind decomposition (two_year_note -> note, no modifier genus) and the 'its yield' possessive are handled correctly. The scalar-change layer is the failure: no delta atom, from/to values flattened into standing measures on the yield, and a tensed participle.
